decision.text: If the reading were a lullaby or market chant, I'd want the reader to stumble a little — hesitate, repeat a line, laugh at their own mistake. That signals it's safe to be imperfect. Would you change the setting, the text, or who's invited?

I'd come if it's short and low stakes — ten minutes, standing room, no introduction round. A market chant or the notice board joke works because nobody has to prep. What I'd change: keep the library door open so people can drift in or out without making a scene.
